Narrow rejection, one figure. The attribution checks out for 17 of 18 quarters (reviewer int_exp.py against companyfacts, plus page reads). 2024-03-31 to 2026-06-30: directors' fees. 2022-06-30 to 2023-12-31: repurchase-transaction interest; the 357 comparative fits, since the 10-Q for 2023-03-31 prints 'Interest and credit facility expenses 2,982 52' and 'Interest expense on repurchase transactions 357' with a dash for 2022, and 357 = 6M 2023 951 less Q2 594. 2022-03-31: published 0 = that dash, while the true line is 52 thousand. The fix (InterestAndDebtExpense, checked in 18 quarters) and the equality detector are now sound: the detector fires in every quarter here and cannot fire where the interest line is published. The defect: 2022-12-31 is described as '2,000 against printed 294,000 thousand interest'. Nothing prints 294,000 thousand. 294,000 (dollars) is the reviewer's r2 figure for repurchase interest derived from companyfacts, not a printed line. The printed fourth-quarter interest is 3,709 (FY 2022, 10-K) less 1,539 (nine months, 10-Q 2022-09-30) = 2,170 thousand, which equals the derived InterestAndDebtExpense of 2,170,000. Also, not_done still says the review found interest_expense = directors' fees 'in every quarter', which contradicts the corrected observation. Fix: restate 2022-12-31 as '2,000 against printed 2,170 thousand (3,709 less 1,539); source of the 2,000 not established' and correct the not_done line.
